relationships.subject: phenylephrine
relationships.evidence_quote: systemic injection of PE but not vehicle increased cluster incidence and number of neurons found in clusters

relationships.subject: Piezo2
relationships.evidence_quote: This blocked the increase in spontaneous pain behaviors induced by i.p. PE injection (Figure 4E) as well as PE-induced clustered firing (Figure 4F).

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: significantly lowered spontaneous pain scores beginning at week 1 post-surgery, with effects lasting over 4 weeks

relationships.subject: PDGFβ
relationships.evidence_quote: PDGFβ is crucial for pericyte recruitment and formation during blood vessel development28, suggesting its elevated levels likely contributed to angiogenesis and pericyte proliferation post-nerve injury.

key_findings: Vasoconstrictors and direct vessel poking evoked clustered firing and spontaneous pain in nerve-injured DRG, blocked by Piezo2 knockdown/knockout or mechanosensitive channel blockers.
Nerve injury increased DRG vessel density, VEGF and pericytes; anti-VEGF bevacizumab reduced vessel density, spontaneous pain and clustered firing.
